newsitem.title: USA: Individual releases First! for Notes 2.0.
newsitem.headline: Individual releases First! for Notes 2.0.

text.p: Individual Inc said on Monday it released First! for Notes version 2.0, a business news and research service for users of International Business Machines Corp's Lotus Notes.

The company said First! for Notes allows users to select the companies and special text searches they want for their daily personalized newsletter and opt for story headlines, briefs or the full story text.
The companies shares were up 2-1/2 to 8-5/8 in late trading on Nasdaq.

First! relies on Individual's exclusive expert system, SMART, or System for Manipulation and Retrieval of Text, to locate and catalogue industry stories from 700 news sources into over 2,500 topic areas. The SMART technology uses content-based analysis based on plain English queries, the company said.

Individual said the service includes features such as news on public and private companies, stored text searches which run automatically to gather news daily, and a personal profile tool for readers to select the topics of greatest interest.

"The new version of First! for Notes provides great improvements in usability and flexibility, not to mention performance, by taking advantage of the some of the new underlying services provided by Lotus Notes Release 4, such as collapsible sections," said Glenn Richards, product manager in IBM's Lotus Development Corp unit's worldwide knowledge architecture and communications group.
First! for Notes version 2.0 is compatible with Lotus Notes Release 4, or later, running on NT or OS/2 servers. Readers with earlier Notes client software are also supported, the company said.
